record.one_liner: B2B data API for go-to-market workflows: find people, enrich contact and company records, match emails, find phone numbers
record.auth_notes: Static API key sent in the x-api-key header. Keys are issued after the team approves an access request. Sub-keys can be created from the master key.
record.access_notes: critic: access confirmed contact_sales. No self-serve signup or free/trial plan; API keys are issued only after team review of a request or a booked call, and per-credit pricing is quoted after a no-cost benchmark on sample data with commitments set at contract.
record.api_notes: Endpoint groups: people search and contact details, company find/enrich, verification, employment checks. Full endpoint list not verified.
record.blocker_notes: critic: confirmed. Credentials only via team-reviewed request / booked call; pricing negotiated. critic: mcp re-checked, search found only third-party waterfall-enrichment MCP articles (pipe0, Floqer, Explorium), no Waterfall.io-owned MCP server, so none.
